noServerHint: Create a server in Hostwerk under Minecraft – then you design its description here.
restartHint: Running – changes take effect after the next restart.
stoppedHint: Stopped – the change applies on the next start.
iconHint: Pick a picture, crop it, save – Minecraft shows it in the server list (64 × 64 pixels).
iconTooBig: The picture is too large (15 MB at most).
problem.lines: More than 2 lines – Minecraft only shows the first two.
problem.long: Line {line} is {n} characters long – the server list cuts it off.
problem.unknown: Unknown § code – it shows up as text.
codesIntro: Codes start with §. A colour resets formats, §r resets everything.
restartRotate: Running – “Restart now” switches to the next variant.
ph.name: Server name
placeholdersInfo: Minecraft only reads the description when the server starts. The studio fills in the placeholders when you save and when you use “Restart now” here – values like the time are from that moment. Players online are shown next to it in the server list anyway.
gradientInfo: Colours the selected text (or the first line) from one colour to the other. server.properties only knows Minecraft’s 16 colours, so the gradient uses the closest ones. Real hex colours need a plugin such as MiniMOTD – use “Copy as MiniMessage” for that.
miniInfo: For plugins like MiniMOTD on Paper
rotate: Switch to the next variant on “Restart now”
problem.placeholder: Unknown placeholder “{name}” – it stays as text.
variantsRotate: {n} variants – the next one comes with “Restart now”.
placeholdersOn: With placeholders – filled in when saving and restarting.
sectionHint: How players see your server in the list.
